state_machine_description: The roulette generates an integer pseudo-random value (0-999) using `rand`. The result branches across tier thresholds: Tier 1 Jackpot (1%), Tier 2 Rare (5%), Tier 3 Common (24%), Tier 4 Consumable (70%). Lucky coins are deducted using `item_delete_by_type`.
probability_or_timing_rules:
Roll < 10: S-Rank / Secret Item (1%)
Roll < 60: Rare Weapon / Armor (5%)
Roll < 300: Grinder / Material (24%)
Roll >= 300: Scape Doll / Trimate (70%)
turnkey_assembly_template:
; Roulette State Machine Loop
700:    rand r50, 1000                  ; Generate random number [0, 999] in R50
        play_se1 13                     ; Roulette spin wheel sound
        sync
        jmpi_lt r50, 10, 710            ; Jackpot Branch (1%)
        jmpi_lt r50, 60, 720            ; Rare Branch (5%)
        jmpi_lt r50, 300, 730           ; Material Branch (24%)
        ; Default Consumable Branch:
        window_msg "You won a <color 1>Scape Doll<color 0>!"
        winend
        ret
710:    window_msg "JACKPOT! You won the <color 2>Secret Prize<color 0>!"
        winend
        ret

mechanic_name: Paganini S-Rank Special & Attribute Upgrade Engine
state_machine_description: Multi-step dialogue state machine where the player selects an eligible weapon, specifies an element or attribute area (Native, A.Beast, Machine, Dark, Hit), and Paganini calls the server packet instruction to deduct Photon Drops or Photon Spheres and apply permanent attributes.
probability_or_timing_rules:
S-Rank Special: Requires 40 or 50 Photon Drops.
Attribute Upgrade: Adds +5% per 20 Photon Drops (up to 50% max). Photon Spheres add +20% (up to 100% max).
turnkey_assembly_template:
; Paganini Special Upgrade Call
800:    ; valueA = Weapon ID, valueB/C/D = Target Special ID, labelE = Success, labelF = Fail
        bb_exchange_pd_srank r150, 0x0000000C, 0, 0, 801, 802
        ret
801:    window_msg "The weapon's true potential has been awakened!"
        winend
        play_se1 15
        ret
802:    window_msg "Transaction cancelled or insufficient Photon Drops."
        winend
        ret

mechanic_name: Pioneer 2 Interactive Soccer Ball & Goal Engine
state_machine_description: Spawn an interactive physical soccer ball (`0x0045`) in the lobby or stage. Players push the ball by walking into it. Goal triggers (`0x0052`) detect when the ball crosses the goal line, trigger celebration fanfare (`play_se1 13`), and increment team score registers.
probability_or_timing_rules:
Physics impulse: Dependent on player movement vector upon collision.
Goal detection: Triggers within radius 25 of goal posts.
turnkey_assembly_template:
; Soccer Goal Clearance Monitor
900:    sync
        ; When ball coordinates enter goal bounding box:
        play_se1 13                     ; Goal fanfare
        addi r80, 1                     ; Team A Score += 1
        window_msg "GOAL! Team A scores!
Score: Team A <color 1><register 80><color 0> - Team B <color 4><register 81><color 0>"
        winend
        ; Respawn ball at center pitch
        ret

state_machine_description: Uses two interleaved background threads. Thread 501 continuously polls opcode 0xF88A for player status 9 (Dead). Upon death, it increments R110 (death counter), broadcasts to all clients via `sync_register`, and sets latch flag R52. Thread 511 waits for the player to revive before clearing latch flag R52, preventing duplicate increments.
probability_or_timing_rules:
Status 0 = Normal, 1 = Poison, 2 = Shock, 3 = Paralyze, 4 = Confuse, 5 = Slow, 6 = Freeze, 9 = DEAD.
Polling interval: 1 vsync frame.
turnkey_assembly_template:
; Dual-Thread Death Counter (Official Sega CMode Logic)
501:    wait_vsync
        jmpi_eq r52, 1, 501             ; If death already latched, wait
        unknownF88A r251, r115          ; Query player status into R115
        jmpi_eq r115, 9, 502            ; If status == 9 (Dead), trigger death handler
        jmp 501

502:    leti r52, 1                     ; Set death latch flag
        let r111, r110                  ; Copy death counter
        addi r111, 1                    ; Deaths += 1
        sync_register 110, 111          ; Sync updated counter across all party members
        play_se1 6                      ; Buzzer sound
        jmp 501

511:    wait_vsync
        jmpi_eq r52, 0, 511             ; If not latched, wait
        unknownF88A r251, r116          ; Query player status
        jmpi_eq r116, 9, 511            ; If still dead, keep waiting
        leti r52, 0                     ; Player has revived! Clear latch flag
        jmp 511
quest_examples: challenge-ep1/c101-bb-e to c109-bb-e, challenge-ep2/d88201 to d88205

state_machine_description: Spawns a continuous countdown timer HUD overlay using `win_time`. A background watcher thread monitors elapsed frames. If time expires before the objective flag is set, the quest immediately terminates with mission failure.
probability_or_timing_rules:
Tick rate: 30 frames per second (e.g. 1800 frames = 1 minute).
Warning alarm triggered when remaining time < 30 seconds.
turnkey_assembly_template:
; Timed Countdown Thread
650:    sync
        subi r90, 1                     ; Decrement remaining frames (R90 initialized to 9000 = 5 min)
        jmpi_le r90, 0, 660             ; Time expired! Jump to Failure
        jmpi_eq r90, 900, 655           ; 30-second warning chime
        jmp 650

655:    play_se1 6                      ; Alarm warning beep
        window_msg "<color 2>WARNING: 30 SECONDS REMAINING!<color 0>"
        winend
        jmp 650

660:    set_qt_failure 661              ; Fail Quest
        ret

state_machine_description: Four floor switches must all be held down simultaneously by players or heavy objects. A polling loop checks the status of all 4 switch flags. Only when all 4 flags equal 1 does the laser fence deactivate and unlock the progression warp.
probability_or_timing_rules:
Requires 4 distinct player positions or pet/box weighted triggers.
Switch timeout reset: 5 seconds if unheld.
turnkey_assembly_template:
; 4-Button Relay Checker
400:    sync
        ; Verify Switch Flags 20, 21, 22, 23
        jmpi_eq r20, 0, 400
        jmpi_eq r21, 0, 400
        jmpi_eq r22, 0, 400
        jmpi_eq r23, 0, 400
        ; All 4 active:
        set_switch_flag_sync 1, 30      ; Deactivate Laser Fence (Switch 30)
        play_se1 15                     ; Pillar activation chime
        ret
